what: blaze_alloc_count::measure cannot say where an allocation happened, so four allocation-budget failures have no lead without running cargo (which lanes may not): hir-ty-borrowck budget a_typical_clean_body (7 allocs, 196 B) and a_large_clean_body (5079), mbe an_expansion_into_a_frame_allocates_nothing (7, 260 B, largest 64: likely a first-locked pthread mutex OnceBox on Apple), syntax-bridge inserted_leaves_allocate_nothing (2 vs 1). Ask: a typed opt-in (e.g. a measure_traced or a thread-local flag set by the test harness, not a hidden env var) that records a std::backtrace::Backtrace per allocation inside measure without recursing, and one round of those four tests with it on, logs to the round dir.
